subject: POC plan & final readout scheduling — LunarPay trial
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@lunarpay.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@lunarpay.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call + POC idea

Neha / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Team is excited about Redwood but we need to make sure a short POC proves two things for our payments flow:

- Accuracy: generated normalization logic must match our existing rules for 95%+ accuracy on merchant normalization and categorization.
- Latency: per-request 95th percentile under 180ms for single-threaded API calls (we'll test with 1k requests/day).

Sofia will own the technical evaluation and I will own the business decision. Can you send a concise POC plan (success criteria, ownership, timeline) so we can get approvals this week?

Also we need to loop in procurement for any trial contract.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Director, Engineering — LunarPay
D: +1 415-555-0148
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@lunarpay.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@lunarpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call + POC idea

Thanks Daniel — attaching a compact POC success criteria workbook and an evaluation plan (PDF) for the team. High-level summary below; full details in attached "poc-success-criteria.xlsx".

POC objective: validate Redwood inference for merchant normalization and classification in LunarPay's payments pipeline.

Success criteria (pass/fail):
- Normalization accuracy >= 95% on a 5k sample (Sofia owner)
- Classification F1 >= 0.92 on labeled set (Sofia owner)
- 95th percentile latency per call < 180ms on representative request mix (Marcus owner, infra config)
- Stable inference under 1k req/day (throughput and KV cache behavior)

Proposed timeline:
- Week 1 (Jul 6–10): environment setup, access & sample data exchange, baseline measurements
- Week 2 (Jul 13–17): model tuning, QA, run evaluation suite
- Week 3 (Jul 20–24): final readout prep + exec readout (proposed Jul 24)

Deliverables: evaluation report, raw run logs (for your engineers), and a final readout slide deck.

Next steps: can you confirm owners (Sofia for eval, Daniel for business), and availability for a 30-min readout window on Jul 24 (AM Pacific)? We'll also share a short agenda and a DocuSign link for a 30-day trial SOW if you want to move quickly.

Attachments: poc-success-criteria.xlsx, poc-eval-plan.pdf

—
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0122
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@lunarpay.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@lunarpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call + POC idea

Thanks — plan looks good. Confirming owners: myself for eval + labeling coordination, Daniel for go/no-go.

A couple of constraints from our side:
- We can only share anonymized merchant data via an S3 bucket (we'll provide a presigned URL).
- Our compliance team requires evidence of SOC2 and data residency notes (can you send docs?).

Quick Q on timeline: can we shift the readout one week later (Jul 31) to allow internal QA time? If so, Jul 31 morning PT works for our execs.

I'll reply with the S3 access details and compliance checklist by EOD.

—
Sofia Martinez
Staff Product Manager — LunarPay
sofia.martinez@lunarpay.com | +1 415-555-0199
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@lunarpay.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call + POC idea

Great — we'll accommodate Jul 31 for the final readout. A few technical notes and owners from our side:

- Marcus (me): infra config + latency tuning, will run load tests and provide 95th percentile numbers.
- Laura Bennett: Solutions Engineer, will help integrate the sample S3 dataset and validate the preprocessing pipeline.
- Priyom Das: Security lead, will provide SOC2 evidence and a short security checklist.

Tech plan (summary):
1) Week of Jul 6: token access & baseline runs on a small 500-record sample.
2) Week of Jul 13: full 5k evaluation; pruning and quantization profiles if needed to hit latency SLO.
3) Week of Jul 20: consolidate results, create slide deck.

We will also prepare a 20-minute exec readout agenda (slides + live demo) and share a calendar invite for Jul 31 AM PT once Sofia confirms a specific time.

Attachments: lunarpay-final-readout-agenda.docx

—
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Final readout invite + pre-read materials (Jul 31)

Hi Daniel & Sofia —

Thanks for confirming the owners and timeline. We have a few quick logistics before the Jul 31 readout:

1) Calendar invite: I will send a 30-min calendar invite for Jul 31, 9:00–9:30 AM PT. Could you confirm if that slot works for your execs?
2) Pre-read: attached the evaluation plan and success criteria workbook for your execs to review.
3) Compliance: Priyom attached a one-page SOC2 summary and I'll route the full package to your procurement via DocuSign when ready.
